acceleration.description: Its acceleration on a change of control, as recorded: none, single or double trigger.

approval_id.description: The approval request waiting, if one is.

checks.description: A draft's status: ✖ while no evidence is attached.

class_account_id.description: The class's share-capital account: the pool's.

currency.description: The exercise price's currency, the base currency.

evidence.description: How many files are attached and not removed: asking for approval needs one, the grant letter.

exercise_price.description: The price per share paid on exercise, in the base currency, from zero.

expires_on.description: The day it lapses, after the grant date.

granted_on.description: The grant date, from which it vests.

holder_id.description: The person the options are granted to: a contact marked investor or shareholder. It stays once drafted.

number.description: The options granted, a whole number above zero, at most what the pool leaves on the grant date.

outstanding.description: The options not exercised, forfeited or lapsed.

recorded_by.description: Who approved it, as it was recorded.

status.description: draft: waiting for the grant letter and approval; recorded: in the register.

version.description: The version of its content; with its status it makes the ETag.

vested.description: What has vested at the end of today (computed, never stored): none before the cliff, then evenly by whole months, rounded down [accountant to confirm].

vesting_months.description: Months it vests over, evenly by month from the grant date; 0 vests it all at once.
